```lean
theorem lg_target {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [LE β] [Zero β] {v₁ : α₁ → β} {v₂ : α₂ → β} : 0 ≤ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ ↔ 0 ≤ v₁ ∧ 0 ≤ v₂ := by
  constructor
  · rw [Sum.elim_le_const_iff]
    exact ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _⟩
  · rw [Sum.const_le_elim_iff]
    exact ⟨zero_le_id, zero_le_id⟩
```
